text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a healthy breakfast and a quick shower. I begin work at nine and follow a regular schedule until five, with a short lunch break in between. After work, I go to the gym three times a week because exercise helps me stay healthy and relaxed. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book for a while. I try to go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent with my routine gives me energy and helps me feel in control of my day.
